lineage.R105_cross_os_note: R103 old baseline differed by 2/128 in seed 1005023; native and all others were bitwise metric-identical.

hypothesis: Within-episode non-token eight-slot role-conditioned causal operator memory with learned factual-action and outcome encoding plus local contradiction-gated evidence will improve action prediction on NEW unseen Boolean laws compared with R105 role-aligned similarity memory and all fully trained, matched-information conventional and negative control arms; eight slots represent all possible observed triple-sign patterns, not eight known formulas or weights.

source.actions: Alternating CALIBRATE/EXPLOIT_POS with 8 each, actual outcomes only.
source.public_factors: R85/R86 physical state with R88 public slots: noisy per-role factor probes [:4,10], role-binding tags [:4,8], action in last row.
source.simulator: R85 pure synthetic world with fresh unique R106 SeedSequence([panel_salt,seed,episode,event]); fresh public physical world and three role assignments; private law truth mask and paired query outcomes evaluator-only.
source.hidden_family_allocation: index%11 FIT/VALID, index%8 heldout; pivot floor(index/num_family)%2; 8 heldout episodes per family per pivot per seed.
source.training_target: Actually chosen query action's scalar reward only; no paired counterfactual action reward in FIT or VALID.
source.heldout_evaluator: Both query action returns and hidden truth only after all 8 trainable arms finish 512 updates; no hidden mask access to learner.

model.role_binding: Trainable smooth assignment of noisy observed factors to publicly marked three causal operand roles.
model.eight_slot_addressing: Differentiable product-basis over all eight three-operand positive/negative signs; fixed slot topology as an inductive bias only, no hardcoded operator law or truth table labels.
model.factual_contradiction_gate: Learned gate from discrepancy between each observed actually chosen action outcome and slot-local leave-one-out predicted return, computed only from same episode factual observations; no counterfactual feedback.
model.memory_write: Differentiable support-weighted eight-slot factual return/observed action memory. Query reads eight slot returns and support density from its own public noisy factors.
model.readout: Learned action-value estimate conditioned on query public role features, eight-slot factual memory, query chosen action, and learned query key. Outer AdamW training remains conventional and counted; in-episode memory never retains original cohort data across episodes.
model.comparison: Same 16 public factual supports and public query for all except frozen ablations; scratch R105 similarity-based native, role-aware GRU64 and MLP64 fully trained. Fixed Bayes256 public-information comparator remains engineering upper control.

evaluation.cross_os_development_reproducibility_rul: Report each arm/seed exact 128-query action counts; any discrepancy >2 of 128 in any arm/seed or different frozen gate status is a reproducibility qualification FAIL; do not silently replace reference run.
